entries.title: Guidance sent just as a task starts on another computer is no longer lost
entries.body: When guidance reached a task on another computer before its work had started there, and more guidance followed, the first message could be dropped and a later one repeated. The task now hears the message it missed, once, when its turn ends.
entries.noPicture: This changes which guidance a crewmate is served next, not a view or control.
entries.noDocsSite: No docs site page describes how guidance reaches a task on another computer.
